d1280-opentop:
Problem: Malaysian trumpet snail can get out of an open top, so the tank needs a lid. A glass top keeps it in and the water warm. Add a glass top (about $23)
No lid: what you get
Nothing between you and the water: the open-top look, no glass strip or hood in the picture
The whole surface is open to the air: the best gas exchange, no film trapped under the lid, and easy feeding and hand access
